local_provider_mapping.method: Map archive-relative site-packages to sysconfig purelib; require actual Conda files membership and verify each managed Python hash
local_provider_mapping.verification_script:
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,sysconfig,hashlib,importlib.metadata as m,zipfile,subprocess
prefix=Path(sys.prefix);pure=Path(sysconfig.get_paths()['purelib'])
h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
expected={
'smonitor':('0.19.0','py_1','4b876b4993b1e2caeed40851402a931f3b245ed7c1916d9483d81bc90274e31c'),
'argdigest':('0.15.0','py_0','b0f22038a8ad1c888dca10adedaca0fa14d2383a685a97c0602b7ca05f29d6a1'),
'depdigest':('0.13.0','py_0','e011d725c8a831ae46cd6b8d114185d04248e32b4d6701c70f988d19cc69f67b'),
'pyunitwizard':('0.28.1','py_0','d4654faf93ed4181bf331f7d382379e78f02784f71f678ad19d0ac43d8062cc6'),
'ackredit':('0.11.0','py_0','df8963ca2d286f50b19eb778e95c54c5ebb79c12fb55a6504e7c23daf5717d4f')}
providers={}
for name,(version,build,sha) in expected.items():
 rec=json.loads(next((prefix/'conda-meta').glob(f'{name}-*.json')).read_text())
 assert (rec['version'],rec['build'],rec['sha256'])==(version,build,sha)
 assert rec['url']==f'https://conda.anaconda.org/uibcdf/noarch/{name}-{version}-{build}.tar.bz2'
 assert m.version(name)==version
 count=0
 for item in rec['paths_data']['paths']:
  rel=item['_path'];path=pure/rel.removeprefix('site-packages/') if rel.startswith('site-packages/') else prefix/rel
  assert str(path.relative_to(prefix)) in rec['files']
  if path.suffix=='.py':
   assert h(path.read_bytes())==item.get('sha256_in_prefix',item['sha256']),path
   count+=1
 providers[name]=dict(version=version,build=build,archive_sha256=sha,verified_python_files=count)
assert all(p['verified_python_files'] for p in providers.values())
wheels={}
for name,folder in [('sabueso','/tmp/recorda-lab15-sabueso-wheel'),('recorda_lab','/tmp/recorda-lab15-lab-wheel'),('recorda','/tmp/recorda22-wheel/dist')]:
 wheel=next(Path(folder).glob('*.whl'))
 with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as z:
  members=[f for f in z.namelist() if f.startswith(name+'/') and not f.endswith('/')]
  for f in members:assert z.read(f)==(pure/f).read_bytes(),f
 wheels[name]=dict(filename=wheel.name,sha256=h(wheel.read_bytes()),installed_members=len(members))
source=Path('/tmp/recorda-lab15-sabueso')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=source).decode().strip()=='68dac8f8bfc35944f5b6dd59aca8cb2a2819388d'
tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','sabueso'],cwd=source).decode().splitlines()
manifest={}
for f in tracked:
 assert subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+f],cwd=source)==(source/f).read_bytes(),f
 if Path(f).suffix in ['.py','.json']:assert (source/f).read_bytes()==(pure/f).read_bytes(),f
 manifest[f]=h((source/f).read_bytes())
print(json.dumps(dict(python=sys.version,executable=sys.executable,providers=providers,wheels=wheels,sabueso_source_sha256=manifest,tool_versions={n:m.version(n) for n in ['pytest','pytest-receptor','numpy','pint','versioningit']}),indent=2))
